The eruption began in Moku’aweoweo, the summit caldera of Mauna Loa, inside the **Hawaii Volcanoes National Park** .

# World's largest active volcano, Mauna Loa, erupts in Hawaii
* By Julianne McShane NBC News
* Nov 28, 2022
* Nov 28, 2022 Updated Jan 1, 2025
*

...

The world's [largest active volcano](https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/hawaiis-big-island-warned-ready-huge-volcano-rumbles-rcna54458) has erupted in Hawaii for the first time in nearly four decades, officials said.
Mauna Loa erupted at 11:30 p.m. local time Sunday (4:30 a.m. ET Monday), the U.S. Geological Survey said.
It was the first eruption since 1984, [according to its Hawaii Volcano Observatory](https://www.usgs.gov/volcanoes/mauna-loa/volcano-updates?utm_medium=email&utm_source=govdelivery) daily update.

...

The most recent eruption followed [weeks of warnings](https://www.hawaiinewsnow.com/2022/10/14/49-magnitude-earthquake-shakes-hawaii-island/) from officials that an eruption was possible given a recent spike in earthquakes at the volcano’s summit and that residents of the Big
Island should be prepared to evacuate, [NBC affiliate KHNL of Hawaii reported](https://www.hawaiinewsnow.com/2022/10/28/mauna-loas-rumbling-continues-message-residents-is-simple-be-prepared/) .
The USGS previously said that “heightened unrest” began in mid-September, when earthquakes beneath the summit increased from 10 to 20 per day to 40 to 50 per day.

...

The volcano, whose name means "Long Mountain," covers half of the island, according to the USGS. Prior to its most recent eruption, it erupted 33 times, beginning in 1843, making it among the world's most active volcanoes.

...

Mauna Loa is erupting for first time in nearly 40 years, rising ashfall concerns.  Lava flows may follow.
[Monica Garrett And Dakin Andone, Cnn](https://www.outtraveler.com/authors/monica-garrett-and-dakin-andone-cnn)
November 28 2022 5:12 AM EST
(CNN) -- The world's largest active volcano, [Mauna Loa](https://www.cnn.com/travel/article/mauna-loa-volcano-unrest-hawaii-trnd/index.html) , is erupting for the first time in nearly 40 years, sparking an ashfall advisory Monday for Hawaii's Big Island and surrounding waters until 6 a.m.
HST (11 a.m. ET).

...

"Based on past events, the early stages of a Mauna Loa eruption can be very dynamic and the location and advance of lava flows can change rapidly," the observatory said, adding, "If the eruption remains in Moku'āweoweo, lava flows will most likely be confined within the caldera walls.
"However, if the eruptive vents migrate outside its walls, lava flows may move rapidly downslope."
_Mauna Loa is erupting for the first time since 1984 photo by USGS_
The eruption began in Moku'āweoweo, the summit caldera of Mauna Loa, on Sunday around 11:30 p.m. HST (4:30 a.m. ET Monday), according to the observatory.
Mauna Loa, which covers half the island of Hawaii, has erupted 33 times since 1843, the volcano's first "well-documented historical eruption," [according to the US Geological Survey](https://www.usgs.gov/volcanoes/mauna-loa) .
It last erupted in 1984, making this prolonged quiet period [the volcano's longest in recorded history](https://www.usgs.gov/volcanoes/mauna-loa/march-25-april-15-1984) .
The volcano has recently been in [a heightened state of unrest](https://www.cnn.com/travel/article/mauna-loa-volcano-unrest-hawaii-trnd/index.html) , per the agency, which pointed in an update late last month to elevated seismic activity and increased earthquake rates.
